name: Delivery Date & Timeslot for WooCommerce
author: dreamfox

sections.description:
Take full control of your WooCommerce delivery schedule with Delivery Date & Timeslot for WooCommerce.

This powerful plugin lets customers choose when their order arrives — directly at checkout. You define lead times, delivery windows, slot duration, and how many orders fit in each timeslot. When a slot is full, it disappears automatically so you never get overbooked.

Perfect for bakeries, florists, meal prep stores, local delivery businesses, and any WooCommerce shop that needs reliable order scheduling without custom development.

👉 Learn more about features, documentation, and premium options: dreamfoxmedia.com

🚀 Why this plugin?

Manual delivery scheduling leads to missed dates, overbooked slots, and endless customer emails asking “When can you deliver?”

With this plugin, you can:
– Let customers pick their delivery date at checkout
– Offer timeslots inside your delivery window (e.g. 08:00–20:00)
– Set a maximum number of orders per slot — full slots hide automatically
– Apply rules per product category so scheduling only shows when it matters
– Show the chosen date and timeslot in orders, emails, and the thank-you page

👉 Result: Fewer missed deliveries, less admin work, and a smoother checkout experience your customers trust.

Key Features

✔ Delivery date picker on the WooCommerce checkout page
✔ Minimum lead time — e.g. require at least 3 days before delivery
✔ Category-based rules — apply scheduling to any product categories, no limit
✔ Delivery date and timeslot shown in admin orders, customer emails, order details, and thank-you page
✔ Lightweight, fast, and easy to configure
✔ No coding required

Delivery Timeslots (free)

✔ Enable or disable timeslots with one toggle
✔ Define your delivery window start and end time (e.g. 08:00 – 20:00)
✔ Choose slot duration: 1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 8, or 12 hours
✔ Set max orders per timeslot — full slots are hidden from customers automatically
✔ Past timeslots on today’s date are filtered out in real time
✔ Live slot preview in admin — see your schedule update as you adjust settings

Built for Performance and Security

✔ HPOS compatible — fully supports WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage
✔ Nonce-verified AJAX, capability checks, and sanitized data throughout
✔ Translation ready — Dutch, English, and German included

Premium Features

Features marked with * are available in the Premium version.

🔥 Unlock advanced delivery management and full scheduling control:

  • ✔* Working days only — count only business days toward lead time
  • ✔* Holiday and blackout dates — block dates customers cannot book
  • ✔* Disable specific weekdays (e.g. no Sunday or Monday deliveries)
  • ✔* Custom delivery date label and description at checkout
  • ✔* Make the delivery date field required
  • ✔* Auto-fill the earliest available delivery date for customers

Upgrade to Premium

Free vs Premium

|| Feature || Free || Premium ||
| Delivery date picker at checkout | ✔ | ✔ |
| Timeslot booking with capacity limits | ✔ | ✔ |
| Category-based scheduling (unlimited categories) | ✔ | ✔ |
| Working days only (lead time) | ✖ | ✔* |
| Holiday / blackout dates | ✖ | ✔* |
| Disable specific weekdays | ✖ | ✔* |
| Custom checkout label & description | ✖ | ✔* |
| Required delivery date field | ✖ | ✔* |
| Auto-fill earliest available date | ✖ | ✔* |

*Premium features are marked with *

How It Works

  1. Go to WooCommerce > Delivery Date in your admin menu
  2. Set your minimum delivery days and select product categories
  3. Enable timeslots, set your delivery window, slot duration, and max orders per slot
  4. Save your settings

At checkout:
– Customers pick a delivery date from the calendar
– Available timeslots load automatically for the selected date
– Full or past slots are hidden — no manual management needed

Simple, powerful, and built for real delivery workflows.

sections.installation:
Automatic installation

  1. Log in to your WordPress dashboard and go to Plugins > Add New.
  2. Search for Delivery Date & Timeslot for WooCommerce.
  3. Click Install Now and then Activate.

Manual installation

  1. Download the plugin zip file.
  2. Go to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  3. Select the zip file and click Install Now.
  4. Click Activate Plugin.

After activation

  1. Go to WooCommerce > Delivery Date in your admin menu.
  2. Set your minimum delivery days and select the product categories the date picker should apply to.
  3. Scroll down to the Timeslot Settings card to enable timeslots, set your delivery window, slot duration, and max orders per slot.
  4. Save and you’re done — the date picker and timeslot selector will appear at checkout.
sections.faq:
Is the timeslot feature free?

Yes, completely free. Enable it under WooCommerce > Delivery Date > Timeslot Settings.

What happens when a timeslot is fully booked?

The slot is automatically removed from the dropdown so customers cannot select it. No manual action required.

Can I set different delivery windows on different days?

That is a Premium feature. The free version applies the same delivery window every day.

Can customers book a delivery for today?

Yes, but only timeslots that have not yet passed. If it is 14:00 and your slots are 2 hours long, the 08:00-10:00 and 10:00-12:00 slots will already be hidden.

Can I add holiday or blackout dates?

Yes, in the Premium version. The free version does not support holiday dates.

Is this plugin compatible with WooCommerce HPOS (High-Performance Order Storage)?

Yes. The plugin is fully compatible with WooCommerce custom order tables (HPOS).

Where can I find documentation and support?

You can find everything you need to get started and go further:

🌐 Website & Premium Features:
https://dreamfoxmedia.com/plugins/delivery-date-for-woocommerce/

📚 Knowledge Base (guides & tutorials):
https://help.dreamfoxmedia.com

🛠 Support (submit a ticket):
https://dreamfoxmedia.com/support-form/

Which languages are supported?

Dutch, English, and German are included. The plugin is fully translation ready via .pot file.

  • Tested with the latest WordPress (7.0.1) and WooCommerce (10.9.4) versions.
  • Fixed Contributors field: “dreamfoxmedia” is not a valid WordPress.org username (was being silently dropped on import); corrected to “dreamfox”.
  • Corrected Stable tag/Version, which had drifted to a stale “2.5.1” that was never actually released (actual last release was 3.0.1) — readme.txt and the plugin header just hadn’t been kept in sync with the real release tags.
  • Removed duplicate hardcoded version strings from the plugin code; the version constant is now read from the plugin header at runtime instead of being copy-pasted in multiple files.

  • Updated Freemius SDK from 2.13.1 to 2.13.2

  • New: Delivery timeslots — enable/disable via settings, set slot duration (1–12 hours), define business window (start and end time), and set max orders per slot
  • New: Customers choose an available timeslot at checkout; full slots are hidden automatically
  • New: Timeslot shown on order confirmation, thank-you page, order details, and customer and admin emails
  • New: Admin settings card with live slot preview
  • New: Past timeslots on today’s date are filtered out automatically
  • Security: nonce verification added to all AJAX handlers
  • Security: removed unauthenticated access to admin AJAX endpoints
  • Security: added capability checks to all admin AJAX handlers
  • Security: escaped all template output with esc_html() and esc_attr()
  • Security: sanitized all POST input with sanitize_text_field( wp_unslash() )
  • Security: replaced direct $_SERVER access with home_url()
  • Security: added JSON decode error handling
  • Security: removed hardcoded nonce placeholder from JavaScript; wired real server-generated nonce end-to-end
  • Updated Freemius SDK from 2.12.2 to 2.13.1
  • Replaced deprecated mysql2date() with wp_date()
  • Fixed text domain inconsistency throughout
  • Tested with WordPress 7.0 and WooCommerce 10.7
